list.name: session_id
list.query: SELECT session_id::text AS __value, coalesce(ai_title, session_id::text) AS __text FROM claude.v_session_token_summary ORDER BY first_event_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_input_tokens + output_tokens AS total_tokens FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT cache_read_pct FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT array_to_string(models, ', ') AS models FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT subagent_count, transcript_count FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT called_at AS time, kind, total_input_tokens + output_tokens AS tokens FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY called_at
SELECT called_at AS time, cache_read_pct, context_growth_tokens FROM claude.v_call_cache_efficiency WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY called_at
SELECT kind, call_index, called_at, delta_seconds FROM claude.v_long_gaps WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY delta_seconds DESC

SELECT agent, agent_type, depth, parent_agent, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY agent, agent_type, depth, parent_agent ORDER BY tokens DESC
SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY model ORDER BY tokens DESC
